title.narrative: Paraguay Strengthening Congressional Legislative Process and Budget Oversight Capacity

description.narrative: "The overall development objectives of this grant is to: (i) strengthen Paraguay's Budget Commission oversight capacity to monitor and evaluate the quality of the budget formulation and execution; and (ii) strengthen Congress' role in formulating and disseminating legislation. By improving the Congressional oversight capacity and the formulation and dissemination of legislation, the IDF would contribute to improve the quality and efficiency of public expenditures and to enhance representation, transparency and accountability of the public sector accounts, and hence increase democratic governance. The overall development objective of this grant is to: (i) Strengthen the Paraguayan Congressional Budget Commission's capacity to monitor and evaluate the quality of budget formulation and execution; and (ii) Strengthen the role of the Congress in formulating and disseminating legislation. By improving the Congress' capacity to oversee, formulate, and disseminate legislation, the IDF would contribute to improve the quality and efficiency of public expenditures and to enhance representation, transparency and accountability of public sector accounts, thereby contributing to increased democratic governance."
